task: Predict Day 2 observed food-group servings from Day 1 food-group servings
dataset: Dietary Behavior Dataset (NHANES paired Day 1 and Day 2 records)
selection_reason: Highest validation variance-weighted R2 among the three non-baseline ML candidates; selection is exploratory and not evidence of clinical recommendation quality.
integration: At inference, blend 30% predicted next-day profile with 70% current food-group profile, then pass blended profile to existing DASH constrained optimizer.
limitations: Prediction of observed next-day intake is not a healthiness or meal-suitability label.
Negative or zero servings are clipped to zero.
The model is experimental; recommendations require user research and dietitian validation.
DASH optimizer constraints are aggregate research constraints, not individualized clinical prescriptions.
